summary: Established the Wardrobe repository control plane: canonical state ledgers, typed task leases, non-overlapping ownership, strict test-first acceptance, independent adversarial review, introduced-history scope and secret scanning, assignment watcher, and trusted GitHub PR gates.

pre_change_proof.evidence: The changed governance tests were applied to pinned base 622c878 and exited 1 before the control-plane implementation.

post_change_proof.evidence: Exact tested code SHA passed 79 of 79 governance tests.
The checked-in board passed schema, lease, dependency, ownership, command-shape, and acceptance validation.
Git diff hygiene passed for base 622c878 through tested code 6f0291b.

adversarial_review.goal: Find fail-open scope, history, secret, acceptance, handoff, or weakened-check routes before bootstrap.

open_risks.description: The current private-repository plan cannot enforce required checks or CODEOWNERS; codex-main remains the sole merger.
Shared GitHub credentials make agent and reviewer identifiers routing labels rather than cryptographic identities.
The first control-plane merge is manually attested because the base predates the trusted runner and the pull_request_target workflow is not yet on the default branch.
The current product base exceeds the target two-failure ceiling; CTRL-001 is control-only and does not claim to repair product tests.
The local full product suite remains resource-refused; focused governance checks are complete and product regression is classified separately.
